title: Parenting Under DFV Stress
learning_goal: Recognise how DFV affects parenting capacity and how to stabilise routines.

content.micro_lesson: DFV-related stress reduces patience, consistency, and emotional bandwidth. Parents may feel guilt or shame. Stabilising routines helps children feel safe.
content.activity: Identify one stressor and one stabilising action to implement.
content.caseworker_flags: Parent expresses hopelessness or inability to cope.
content.escalation_trigger: Parent reports inability to keep child safe triggers immediate triage.
